messages:
samir_k: Hi team — day 2 and hitting weirdness. Tried to do a Time Machine restore from my personal drive onto the company M2 Air. Restore completed but when I try to sign into my enterprise account I get a blank login window and Keychain passwords aren't appearing. Also Migration Assistant said "skipping encrypted user data" even though I pointed to the user. FileVault is on the new machine. Any recommended safe path? Don't want to disable FileVault if we can avoid it.

it_ops: hey @samir_k welcome — sounds like the Time Machine backup had an encrypted user snapshot that the restore couldn't attach to your managed account. Two safe options:

Option 1 (recommended, minimal config changes): Boot into Recovery on the new Mac, unlock the APFS volume with your personal recovery passphrase (we can help), mount the backup image and export `~/.ssh` and Keychain items, then import into the managed account. This preserves FileVault. Steps we can assist with.

Option 2 (clean but heavier): Create temporary local admin, restore into that admin account, then transfer files into the enterprise account and delete temp admin. This is similar to Migration Assistant but gives more control over ownership.

amira_se: quick note — if you restored from a backup that had iCloud Keychain items, those won't come over unless you sign into iCloud and have two-factor. Don't copy keychain db files directly. Use Keychain Access > File > Import Items where possible.

mdm-bot: MDM event: device enrolled at 2025-01-14T09:12:05Z. Profile compliance: pending user keychain sync.

it_ops: we can also push a one-time helper profile that temporarily grants admin for 3 hours and mounts backups under IT supervision. We provide a company encrypted USB if you want to avoid network transfer. Which would you prefer?

samir_k: I'd rather use the helper profile + encrypted USB. I don't have a company USB yet. Can IT drop one at my desk? I'm in SF office.

platform_access: @samir_k we can put a flash in the office mailroom. Leave a note at security with your badge and they'll hand it to you. Also, once keys are on device we can check SSO certs for repo access.

it_ops: pushed `temp-admin-3h` at 2025-01-14T09:20:40Z. Okta secure message sent with username. Please collect the encrypted USB from mailroom before starting. We'll do steps with you on a screen share if needed.

mdm-bot: MDM event: device marked compliant at 2025-01-14T09:28:11Z.

samir_k: followed the plan, IT assisted via screen share. Restored into temp admin, exported `~/.ssh` and used Keychain Access import for VPN certs and saved SSO cookie to the enterprise keychain. Fixed ownership with `sudo chown -R samir_k /Users/samir_k` and set permissions. Logged into enterprise account, iCloud keychain re-synced after sign-in and 2FA. Everything looks normal now.

amira_se: great — ping me when you need repo access and we'll add your SSH key to the deploy team.

it_ops: temp-admin auto-revocation scheduled; we'll confirm it's revoked in an hour. Reopen if anything else pops up.

samir_k: thanks everyone, really smooth. Appreciate the USB drop and the assist :thumbsup:
